Everything we do

The whole list, briefly.

I

Paint Protection Film

XPEL Ultimate Plus and Stealth, wrapped past the edges so there's no visible line. Ten-year warranty, self-healing.

Paint protection film
II

Ceramic Coating

Fusion Plus, Ceramic Pro, and Revivify — applied over corrected paint, never over defects.

Ceramic coating
III

Detailing & Correction

Multi-stage correction that removes what the last shop left behind, before anything goes on top.

Detailing
IV

Glass & Windows

Prime XR Plus and Vision tint, windshield film, and nano coating for the glass you look through.

Glass & windows
V

ECU Tuning & Coding

ETG and Pro Tuning Freaks calibration, BMW coding, DME unlock, TCU work, pedal boxes.

Performance tuning
VI

Service, Track & Tires

Scheduled maintenance, brake and fluid work, track preparation, wheel fitment and seasonal storage.

Service & tires
